RUN-FACTS

assertion messages. Anonymous Apex emitted one debug message for each case.

in cases.tsv. Each selected case has a row at all three APIs in both routes.

NEIGHBOR PROBES

The precise invalid-day error text, early-calendar display for year-zero instants before hybrid year 1, date-only input, negative years, offsets crossing into negative years, and JSONParser.getDatetimeValue are outside the fix.
